content: shadcn's Carousel component already forwards a plugins prop to embla-carousel-react's useEmblaCarousel hook (confirmed in components/ui/carousel.tsx). Standard autoplay pattern: import Autoplay from 'embla-carousel-autoplay'; const plugin = React.useRef(Autoplay({ delay: 4000, stopOnInteraction: true })); <Carousel plugins={[plugin.current]} onMouseEnter={plugin.current.stop} onMouseLeave={plugin.current.reset}>. No changes needed to the existing carousel.tsx primitive.
